rules.title: Reward offered for a review or for a positive review
rules.message: The FTC rule bans rewards conditioned on a review expressing a sentiment (16 CFR 465.4); Google, Yelp and Meta bar any reward for a review at all. Ask for honest reviews with no reward.
rules.source: FTC Rule on Consumer Reviews and Testimonials, 16 CFR 465.4; Endorsement Guides 16 CFR 255; Google Maps user-contributed content policy (incentivized reviews)

rules.title: Invented or ghost-written customer review or testimonial
rules.message: Never write a review or testimonial for a customer. Quote real reviews only verbatim, with the reviewer's consent where the vertical needs it, and name the source.
rules.source: FTC Rule on Consumer Reviews and Testimonials, 16 CFR 465.2

rules.title: Partner, gifted or paid mention without a disclosure
if_any: \b(in partnership with|sponsored by|thanks to our partner|gifted by|courtesy of)\b
rules.message: If anything of value changed hands, say so plainly (#ad, Paid partnership).

rules.title: Suggests trending or popular music for a business account
rules.message: Business accounts on Instagram and TikTok may use only the commercially cleared library (Meta Sound Collection, TikTok Commercial Music Library) or licensed audio.
rules.source: Instagram Help 402084904469945; TikTok Commercial Music Library help

rules.title: Ticket or lodging price that may leave out mandatory fees
rules.message: For live-event tickets and short-term lodging the advertised price must be the total including mandatory fees. Say "all-in" and mean it, or drop the price.
rules.source: FTC Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees, 16 CFR 464 (effective 2025-05-12)

rules.title: Unfilled placeholder in the post
rules.message: A placeholder would go out as is. Fill it from memory or ask the user.
